limitations: Single run per corpus and one concurrent-restore sample; filesystem caches uncontrolled.
CLI warm medians include process startup, IPC and sync checks; query medians use direct local IPC.
Each request shape has a cold cache miss; distribution limit500 first miss is included in raw samples.
Query corpus is one day, so limit1/limit500 are not a paging scalability comparison.
Index bytes include WAL before service exit, not steady-state compacted database size.
First threads query (100k) 372.46 to 397.12 ms and 10k cold sync 549.51 to 584.26 ms did not improve; do not claim all paths accelerated.
Full safe-fact traversal and index rebuilding remain; no million-record or 24-hour acceptance.
No new real-source, Windows/Linux or browser-interaction acceptance.
